name: Nexus Server
author: lioner2008@users.noreply.github.com
description:
Nexus social server (https://github.com/Lioner2008/Nexus): accounts, text chat, voice/video call signaling and a built-in TURN relay for the Nexus game launcher.

The server listens on the primary allocation (TCP). With the TURN relay switched on it also needs the UDP ports 'TURN port' (default 3478) and 'Relay ports' (default 49160-49200) allocated to this server; voice and video are then relayed through them when the players' NATs do not allow a direct connection.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Nexus Server – Pterodactyl install script (embedded in egg-nexus-server.json).
# Runs once in the install container (ghcr.io/pterodactyl/installers:alpine) with the
# server volume mounted at /mnt/server. Downloads the Linux build that every GitHub
# release of Nexus ships (nexus-server-linux-x64) and checks it against SHA256SUMS.txt.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

REPO="Lioner2008/Nexus"
ASSET="nexus-server-linux-x64"
VERSION="${NEXUS_VERSION:-latest}"
VERSION="${VERSION// /}"
SUMS=""

if [ -n "${NEXUS_DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    URL="${NEXUS_DOWNLOAD_URL}"
elif [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/latest/download/${ASSET}"
    SUMS="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/latest/download/SHA256SUMS.txt"
else
    case "${VERSION}" in v*) ;; *) VERSION="v${VERSION}" ;; esac
    URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/${VERSION}/${ASSET}"
    SUMS="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/${VERSION}/SHA256SUMS.txt"
fi

echo "Downloading ${URL}"
if ! curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o nexus-server.download "${URL}"; then
    echo "ERROR: download failed. Does release '${VERSION}' have a '${ASSET}' asset?"
    echo "       Check https://github.com/${REPO}/releases (Linux builds exist from v0.5.2 on)"
    echo "       or set 'Download URL' to a direct link of a Linux x86_64 nexus-server binary."
    rm -f nexus-server.download
    exit 1
fi

if [ -n "${SUMS}" ] && curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o SHA256SUMS.txt "${SUMS}" 2>/dev/null; then
    expected="$(awk -v f="${ASSET}" '$2 == f { print $1 }' SHA256SUMS.txt)"
    if [ -n "${expected}" ]; then
        actual="$(sha256sum nexus-server.download | awk '{ print $1 }')"
        if [ "${expected}" != "${actual}" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: SHA-256 mismatch for ${ASSET} (expected ${expected}, got ${actual})"
            rm -f nexus-server.download SHA256SUMS.txt
            exit 1
        fi
        echo "SHA-256 verified"
    fi
    rm -f SHA256SUMS.txt
fi

mv -f nexus-server.download nexus-server
chmod +x nexus-server
mkdir -p nexus-data
echo "Installed: $(./nexus-server --version)"
echo "Set the variables on the Startup tab (invite code, TURN relay, public address), then start the server."

variables.name: Invite code
variables.description: Friends need this code to create an account. Leave empty for open registration - not recommended on a server that is reachable from the internet.

variables.name: TURN relay
variables.description: On: the built-in TURN relay makes voice and video work even when both players are behind strict NATs. Needs the UDP ports 'TURN port' and 'Relay ports' allocated to this server. Off: signaling only, calls must connect peer-to-peer.

variables.name: TURN port
variables.description: UDP port of the TURN relay. Must be allocated to this server (default 3478).

variables.name: Relay ports: first
variables.description: First UDP port for relayed media. Every simultaneous relayed stream uses one port; the whole range must be allocated to this server.

variables.name: Relay ports: last
variables.description: Last UDP port for relayed media (at least 'Relay ports: first').

variables.name: Public address
variables.description: Public IP or host name of this node, announced to players for relayed media. Leave empty to use the IP of the allocation (works when the node's allocations use its public IP).

variables.name: Version
variables.description: Release to install: 'latest' or a tag such as v0.5.2 (Linux builds exist from v0.5.2 on). Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Download URL (advanced)
variables.description: Direct link to a Linux x86_64 nexus-server binary, for forks or own builds. Overrides 'Version'; not checked against SHA256SUMS.txt.
